nodes.label: White Background Image
nodes.description: A small solid white PNG image used as a background or placeholder asset in the E-Tipitaka-PC application UI. Likely used for blank states, spacers, default backgrounds, or as a base layer for compositing other UI elements.

nodes.label: UI Background Asset
nodes.rationale: A plain white image serves as a neutral background or placeholder in the UI, providing a clean canvas for text rendering and visual layering in the Tipitaka reader interface.
